subject: general
question: Pandit Birju Maharaj was conferred with which of the following awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Vibhushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj **was conferred with **the Padma Vibhushan award**.
 
• Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India, which is given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including service rendered by government servants.
 
• Shaurya Chakra is a military award given for acts of gallantry in the face of the enemy.
 
• Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, which is given for distinguished service of a high order in any field, including service rendered by government servants.
 
• Padma Shri is the fourth-highest civilian award in India, which is given for distinguished service in any field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Indian dancer, singer, composer, and representative of the **Lucknow "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance** was **Pandit Birju Maharaj**.
 
• His father and guru, Acchan Maharaj, as well as his two uncles, Shambhu Maharaj and Lachhu Maharaj, were all members of the Maharaj family of Kathak dancers.
 
• He began his career with his uncle Shambhu Maharaj, working alongside him at Bhartiya Kala Kendra and then Kathak Kendra in New Delhi.
 
• He led the latter organization for a number of years before retiring in 1998 to start his own dance school, Kalashram, in Delhi.
